description: Whether a publication request may be made -- never whether one was made. performed is always false: there is no argument that makes it true, because there is no code here that publishes.

github_check_head.description: Must be the same commit as the local receipt. Two heads are two facts about a different commit each, and 'local is green and CI is green' is true of neither.

receipt_kinds.description: Kept separate. Folded into one, 'the sync ran' and 'a human admitted it' become the same record, and only one of them is a decision.

title: Git Town publication decision
